candidates.change_summary: Increment proposalCount after setting grant details instead of before; this can change the observable value of proposalCount when NewProposal is emitted (proposalCount will reflect old value in event).
Do not increment proposalCount at all (remove the increment), leaving proposalCount unchanged after the call and storing grant under current proposalCount, changing observable proposalCount.
Double-increment proposalCount (add an extra increment), so proposalCount increases by 2 per call, changing its value after the call.
Increment a different state variable (proposalCount replaced with coolOffPeriod) so proposalCount is not updated by this function, changing observable proposalCount.
Set VADER to _usdv instead of _vader in init, causing VADER to differ after init when different addresses passed.
Do not assign VADER at all in init (remove assignment), leaving VADER unchanged after init.
Assign VADER to the zero address instead of _vader in init, making VADER different after init.
Swap assignments: set VADER = _vault and VAULT = _vader so VADER differs after init.
After normal assignments, overwrite VADER with msg.sender, changing VADER after init to the caller address.
